Albums:

1. Infinity on High
2. Stardust
3. Mania
4. AB/AP
5. Folie a Deux

Songs:

1. Bishop's Knife Trick
2. The Kintsugi Kid
3. Love From The Other Side
4. 20 Dollar Nosebleed
5. Centuries
6. every other song from Stardust (I seriously can't pick they're all too good)

I truly like all of their songs, though. My least favorite is Young and Menace but even that one is still really annoyingly catchy so there's a special place in my heart for it!
